stops.name: Southampton

clue.citationMla: The new North-west. (Deer Lodge, MT) 29 Nov. 1889, p. 1. Retrieved from the Library of Congress, www.loc.gov/item/sn84038125/1889-11-29/ed-1/.
clue.excerpt:
"NELLIE BLY'S" ROUTE.
Nov. 22. Leave Victoria station, London, 8 p. m., on India mail.
Nov. 23. Calais, Paris and Turin.
Nov. 24. Brindisi at 10:14 p. m.
Nov. 25. Leave Brindisi, steamship Cathay, 2 a. m.
Nov. 27. Ismailia
Dec. 3. Aden.
Dec. 10. Colombo (Ceylon).
Dec. 16. Penang.
Dec. 18. Singapore.

stops.summary: She is due in Southampton and rides by rail to London in three hours.
stops.title: Due in Southampton
stops.hint: Listen, kid, she hops rails to London then dashes across to France — follow south.

stops.name: Colombo

clue.citationMla: The Evening World. (New York, NY) 13 Dec. 1889, p. 7. Retrieved from the Library of Congress, www.loc.gov/item/sn83030193/1889-12-13/ed-2/.
clue.excerpt: If no untoward incident prevents Nellie Bly will sail from Colombo, Ceylon, to-day. She has been delayed there five days waiting for a connecting steamship. Should no more unexpected delays intervene she will yet reach Hong Kong in time to embark on the Oceanic, as scheduled before she left New York

stops.summary: She sails from Colombo today after five days waiting for a connecting steamship.
stops.title: Five-Day Wait Ends
stops.hint: Listen, kid, she's steaming east toward China — find the next British coaling port past the Bay.
